proposals.evidence: Dhakal p. 46 prints /hõʦo/ “short.” Turner14084 section 5 explicitly gives Nepali hõco and hoco “low, short,” plus Jaunsari hochā “short.” The nasal vowel and affricate distinguish this branch from the article’s other defective-word sections.

proposals.evidence: Dhakal p. 55 prints /tʰunʰi/ “pillar of wood” and notes breathy /nʰ/ as a predictable intervocalic feature. Turner13774 gives Old Awadhi thūnī “small pillar,” Bhojpuri thūnhī “prop,” and Pali/Prakrit thūṇā “post, pillar”; these support the Darai wooden-post noun.
